q: Which side of the house is best suited for placing the Toilet and Bath?
n: The west absorbs the strongest afternoon sun, which is acceptable for a wet, briefly-occupied service area but poorly suited to spaces meant for longer, comfortable occupancy — per the source document.

q: Where is the ideal location on a site for the septic tank?
n: The southwest keeps the tank clear of habitable-space areas and supports the soil drainage and percolation associated with that side of the lot — per the source document.

q: Which of the following is generally discouraged along the southern edge of a lot?
n: Large arboreal trees develop wide, deep root systems that can eventually undermine foundations and utility lines as they mature, so planting them near the southern boundary is discouraged — per the source document.

q: Under typical Philippine climate conditions, which cardinal direction is the most suitable orientation for the Master Bedroom?
n: A north-facing room gets soft, indirect daylight and avoids the intense afternoon heat gain of a west or south exposure, keeping it cooler for rest — per the source document.

q: To make the most of a site's natural features while still controlling heat on the southern side, which design strategy is most advisable in a Philippine setting?
n: A light shelf canopy shades the opening below it from harsh southern sun while bouncing daylight deeper into the interior, capturing illumination without the heat load — per the source document.
